title: Pilchard Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish made with pilchards and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the pilchards, ground spices, and diced tomatoes (if using).
Cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the pilchards are cooked through.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot over couscous or rice.
Garnish with additional parsley and lemon wedges, if desired.
